supplementary_datasets.ISCX-VPN: M0/M1 frozen external scores available; no frozen M2
supplementary_datasets.ISCXTor2016: M0/M1 frozen external scores available; no frozen M2

score_definitions.D_proto: 0.5 * minimum squared Euclidean distance from mu to learned prototype
score_definitions.M1: minimum squared Euclidean distance from mu to Known-Train empirical centroid
score_definitions.support_d1_d2: first and second Euclidean distances to Known-Train empirical centroids
score_definitions.prototype_gap: Euclidean learned-prototype to matching empirical-centroid distance
score_definitions.closed_confusion_strength: Known-Validation native off-diagonal rate for the unknown sample's nearest empirical-centroid class
score_definitions.ranking_complementarity: exact unknown-known pair ordering; correct iff unknown score > paired Known-Test score

evaluation.threshold: existing method-specific Known-Validation P95; recomputed only for parity
evaluation.correlation_scope: exploratory because protocol-class rows are not independent

gate.COMPLEMENTARITY_CONFIRMED: VNAT has both positive and negative M1-vs-M0 class-protocol deltas in at least 20% of units each; both methods contribute at least 10% of discordant exact ranking decisions and operating-point rescues; at least one preregistered mechanism variable has |Spearman rho| >= 0.30 with p < 0.05 in the predicted direction; directionally similar gain/loss regimes occur in at least one supplementary dataset.
gate.PARTIAL_COMPLEMENTARITY: Bidirectional rescue and both gain/loss regimes exist, but one or more stability, mechanism-correlation, or cross-dataset conditions for confirmation is absent.
gate.NO_USEFUL_COMPLEMENTARITY: Rescue is effectively one-sided, or one method dominates without repeatable opposing failure regimes.

forbidden: threshold tuning on Test or Unknown
